summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-print feature in the rich repo, without running any tests or committing. Changes: new rich/json.py (JSON renderable plus a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and an "Unable to read" error path); JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json placed after print in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; new tests test_print_json in tests/test_console.py and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py; a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst; a new docs/source/reference/json.rst added to reference.rst; and a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased. Choices: overflow set to Python None (the spec's "none"), and from json import dumps, loads to avoid shadowing by the json parameter. Not verified: the expected ANSI output in test_print_json, which was derived by reading Style and print code, and the regex and black formatting, which were checked by reading only.
